same_metric_leagues.model: RidgeCV, one model for USL Championship, USL League One and MLS NEXT Pro (league terms and league x goals-added slopes)
same_metric_leagues.target: MLS goals added per 96 minutes in the next season
same_metric_leagues.validation: 5-fold, grouped by player (no player in both train and test)

basic.cv: 5-fold grouped by player, MLS 2023-2026, outfield, 450+ minutes

rich.cv: 5-fold grouped by player, MLS 2023-2026, outfield, 450+ minutes

box_score_calibration.source: MLS consecutive seasons 2023-2026 (box score in season t, goals added in t+1)

box_score_leagues.league_strength: team ratings from 2023-2026 results (domestic leagues + Leagues Cup, Concacaf Champions Cup, Libertadores, Sudamericana, Club World Cup), league = average club rating 2025-2026; scaled to goals added by one factor fitted on movers into MLS
box_score_leagues.validation: each mover into MLS left out of the league-strength fit, then predicted (calibration comes from MLS players only)
